items.name: 0nlytype
items.title: 0nlyType
items.description: 0nlyType tokens, the default font pair, the reset and the base pieces, with a Tailwind v4 theme bridge.

items.name: fonts-press
items.title: Pair: press
items.description: Schibsted Grotesk and Newsreader, for <html data-pair="press">.

items.name: fonts-paris
items.title: Pair: paris
items.description: Instrument Sans and EB Garamond, for <html data-pair="paris">.

items.name: fonts-salon
items.title: Pair: salon
items.description: Bricolage Grotesque and Cormorant, for <html data-pair="salon">.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: One link: a hairline underline at rest, and pointing at it, focusing it or holding its card open draws a highlighter stroke through the whole word, on from the left and off to the right.

items.name: meta
items.title: Meta
items.description: A frame row: small words held apart by hairlines that stretch to fill the row.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key, drawn as the corners of its cap. Pressed, the corners close into the whole cap and it goes down a little.

items.name: corners
items.title: Corners
items.description: Four corner marks: a frame that doesn't close.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: One family of three (a statement in an ink block, a bracket that steps apart, a quiet line that redraws), four heroes for the big call to action (overture, crescendo, stave and ink), and two measures: space and repeat. Nothing moves its neighbours.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: The wait, written the way a score writes it: periods, a round, a metronome, a fermata, a breath, a rising chord, or the word itself being inked.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: No box. The words are the control, and checking strikes them through in the accent.

items.name: fraction
items.title: Fraction
items.description: A count set as a display fraction: yours large in italic, the total small beside it, a pen stroke between. A changed number turns over.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Words in a row. The one you choose turns italic, because it's yours now. One dot glides beneath it along a slur, or the italic itself slides through the words to it and sets a full stop after it. A ballot cross can be written after it, or, in a heavy column, its italic swells.

items.name: dial
items.title: Dial
items.description: A number you turn to. The arc sets a few on a half circle and rolls to your choice; the tuner is a long scale on the rim of a wheel you turn by hand, by scroll or by key, and your number reads above it in italic. Dynamics sets the number at the size of its loudness, from niente to fff; the tumbler sets a whole number figure by figure, like the wheels of a lock.

items.name: picks
items.title: Picks
items.description: A list of choices that carry their own content. The one you took turns italic, and either a dot slides to it along a plucked string its initial hangs in the margin like a rubricated capital, its name lies faint behind the list, or two registration crosses mark its corners.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A sentence whose last word you can change. The state rolls between on and off in italic, and the full stop answers: a dot when on, a ring when off.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A ruler with a hand. The value is drawn as a dimension from zero with your number in italic in the gap, or runs through the label's spread letters, or makes the label as loud as the value.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: No box, only a baseline. Your words arrive in italic, focus draws the accent from where you touched, and an error hangs from the line as a callout. Or your words are overprinted on a heavy label, or signed on a form's line.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A choice set inside a sentence: the chosen word is yours, italic over a hairline. It can be reset from the last word's letters, or wear the other choices above it as ruby.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Words with their counts raised. A line inches to the one in view and the count of what's showing sinks into the rule; or the chosen word takes its width from the others; or the rule beside a stack of words opens onto the panel.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Numbers with a dot beneath each, weight falling away from the current page and its accent dot; or a folio, the page over its total; the neighbours, by name; every page as a barcode's line; or an alphabet set as one word.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path, divided by drawn hairlines leaning like slashes; or a stair that ends in the large italic of where you are; or a long path with a full stop for each step left out.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Questions you open. Ruled off, with a plus that winds into a cross as the question swells into a heading; or run in with their answers like a book's paragraphs; glossed in the outer column; or stood side by side as columns that widen.

items.name: rows
items.title: Rows
items.description: An index of hairline-separated rows. The one you point at reverses out of ink and steps forward with an arrow; or repeats are set as ditto marks; or a ring before each row fills once you have been there.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month drawn as time, after the "28 December" poster: a huge numeral, then a large disc for every day, ink for the days gone, the accent for today, rings for the days to come, and half-moons for the wait. The ruler draws the same month as one measured line; the ghost sets the days against the date huge and faint behind them; the parenthesis runs the month as a line of figures with the wait in parentheses.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: The one rounded shape: a hairline pill for a tag or a status; or tags written as one list in the italic; or a seal with its legend set round a ring.

items.name: note
items.title: Note
items.description: Marginalia: a dotted term, and a leader line that draws out to its note; or a gloss set over the word; an abbreviation that opens into its words; or a word struck through and rewritten.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far something you started has got: a hairline and an italic percentage, the words themselves inking in, one ring per item, a pair of parentheses closing on the words, or a tally. Done, a full stop lands.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: One line rises from the bottom-left; a fermata held over its last word empties while it stays.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: The question, set large, with two plain answers. The page holds still behind it.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: An invitation to act, not an apology: what is missing, and the one thing to do about it. Under half a zero, under the score's tacet, or on a page left blank on purpose.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A word you can hold down. Held, it's yours and turns italic: under a fermata's arc and dot, behind a pen that inks the tenuto's line, with a small note hung beside it, or set on its drawn guides.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: Words in a row you can hold down, one or many; held neighbours are tied under one slur or share one pair of parentheses, held words are numbered in the order you held them, or cross into the margin.

items.name: button-group
items.title: Button group
items.description: A set of actions, drawn three ways: one pair of parentheses with hairlines between, a narrow column with a dash hung in the margin, or a list written into the sentence around it.

items.name: input-group
items.title: Input group
items.description: Ours in roman, yours in italic, on one line. The accent draws only under the part you type. Or your figure stands large with our words stacked beside it, or an arrow leads from your words to the action.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: A one-time code on short baselines, three and three. Digits drop in as you type; whole, the lines ink in turn. Or the code closes up into one figure, or is read back in words under its digits.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: A field that suggests. Type and the letters you typed are marked in each match, the suggestions arrive in turn, and what you chose sits on the line in italic; with multiple, your choices are written there as one sentence.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel hung from what opened it, on a leader line. Escape or a click elsewhere puts it away.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context menu
items.description: The same list of words, opened where you pressed and spreading from that point like ink.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A list of words on the popover panel; the one you point at is marked with the highlighter.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: A frame row of words on a hairline; opening a word folds the line down into a pocket that holds its menu.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation menu
items.description: Small words open a panel of large names, the scale contrast of a poster; or a contents page with one name set as the headline; or the names opened into the line itself.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: What you type is set as large as a headline, in italic. Matches are marked; the chosen row steps forward. Or every row set on one axis at its match, as a mesostic; or the groups run on, as a book's index.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: A column of words beside the work. Folded, it becomes a ruler: a numeral for each group, a tick for each link, and the name comes out into the margin when you point at it.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A column under a rule, not a box. Point at it and an ink stroke passes along the rule.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover card
items.description: Point at a name and wait a moment: a card opens with the name set large and cropped by its edge.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A whisper in parentheses above the thing it names.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A page slid in from the edge, its title running up the spine like a book's; or a row that unfolds into its page.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A sheet from below, lifted by the fermata's arc. Drag the arc down to put it away.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: A list that ends in the rest of itself: the words "and 4 more" are the control.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: Panes and the rule between them. Take the rule and it inks; while you hold it, each pane's share is drawn as a dimension.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: A rule appears at an edge only while there's more beyond it, and leaves when you reach the end.

items.name: scrollbar
items.title: Scrollbar
items.description: A scrollbar as a ruler: a hairline, a mark where each section begins, and an ink thumb as long as the view.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect ratio
items.description: A frame kept to a ratio and marked the way a printer marks a crop: short lines outside each corner, never a border.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: One poster at a time, each name set so large the frame crops it. The count between the arrows rolls the way you travel.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Hairline rows in tabular figures; the column you sort by is set in ink, or set loud; or the row and column you point at cross in ink.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Hairlines and dots against one very large number that rolls to the bar you point at.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A person is a ring and their initial, in italic, since a name is theirs; or a monogram of both initials; or the given name set to fill one width.

items.name: item
items.title: Item
items.description: A ledger line: what it is, a dotted leader, what you can do. Point at it and the leader inks across. Or every fifth line numbered in the margin; or the description running along the leader.

items.name: typography
items.title: Typography
items.description: Long text, set to be read: it styles plain HTML by element, and punctuation hangs in the margin.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: No balloons. Of the speech bubble only its tail is left, a leaning hairline. What they wrote is roman; what you wrote sits on the other side, in italic.

items.name: marker
items.title: Marker
items.description: A quiet line in a conversation: a status, where a day begins, where you left off, or how long it went quiet.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment
items.description: A file's extension is its picture; a ring counts it in and fills to a dot when it's safe.

items.name: thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: A message scroller that keeps to the latest while you are at the end. Scrolled back, it stays put and counts what is new in an ink pill.

items.name: questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questions one at a time, set large. The count rolls and a hairline fills; each question turns in from the side you're heading. At the end your answers are written into one sentence, in italic, arriving word by word.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A double bar: in a score, the sign that something changes here.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Where the words will be: their baselines, the guides a letterer rules for them, or their rhythm. Still until something is loading, and still when motion is off.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: A date inside a sentence, like the select. It opens the month on a leader line; choose a day and it is written into the sentence in italic.

items.name: activity-feed
items.title: Activity feed
items.description: A history of what happened, grouped by day: who, what, and a dotted leader to when, on one hairline down the margin. The newest carries the accent; the rest waits behind "and 4 more".

items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent chat
items.description: Talk to an agent. Its words are roman and yours arrive in italic; it asks before it acts, in a question you must answer, and it tells you what it is doing as a sentence that inks in.

items.name: agent-state
items.title: Agent state
items.description: Where an agent is, in one quiet line: a ring, a breath, a round, the accent disc or an ink disc, and the word for it.

items.name: appearance
items.title: Appearance
items.description: Choose the look: scheme, key and type pair as three lists of picks, and the answer written back as one sentence, “Cotton, in ultramarine, set in Archivo and Bodoni.”, which the night toggle finishes. The new page opens as a circle from whatever you touched.

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Volume as a barcode: no fill, only hairlines dropped from the line to the baseline at a close, even rhythm.

items.name: calligram
items.title: Calligram
items.description: A paragraph that fills a shape, as Apollinaire's calligrams did: each line is as wide as the shape is at that height, so the outline is only implied. Or it falls as rain, or runs round a frame about one word.

items.name: command-line
items.title: Command line
items.description: One line to type, on a baseline like a field already filled in. The address recedes, the part that's yours is italic, and copying draws the line in the accent.

items.name: contour
items.title: Contour
items.description: A paragraph set to a contour, the way a score draws a swell: each line laid to its own width, so the words taper, open or swell and close.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Records you narrow with a sentence, sort by pressing a heading (the column turns ink and the rows glide), and page at a folio, or read on as the table ends in the rest of itself.

items.name: dropzone
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: Files, dropped or chosen. The area is only its corner marks, and files carried over it close them in; the sentence is a real file input, and what you hold is listed as attachments.

items.name: figure
items.title: Figure
items.description: A picture cropped to a ratio and marked like a printer's proof, its number, caption and credit set in type underneath or in the margin beside it.

items.name: form
items.title: Form
items.description: Fields on the grid and one statement button. A failed send gives each field its callout and focuses the first; while sending, the button says so. Or write it as a letter with a postscript, or have it postmarked when it's sent.

items.name: gather
items.title: Gather
items.description: A line whose letters, words or rows start as dust, as the mirrored forme or wound in a coil, and settle into place as it scrolls into view, or step by step with the scroll, then give way to the real text.

items.name: grid
items.title: Grid
items.description: A quiet structure behind a section: a faint square grid, or a fine point at each crossing, with a registration cross on each corner and the columns numbered and the rows lettered along the border, like a drafting sheet. It never moves.

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line chart
items.description: One hairline through the points, a ring on each, against one very large number that rolls to the point you're on.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A band of words that drifts through a clipped frame. Scroll takes over; a small pause word lets it rest.

items.name: measure
items.title: Measure
items.description: A paragraph whose measure you set by dragging its right edge, with the number of characters a line and a verdict on it.

items.name: melody
items.title: Melody
items.description: A sentence set on a stave, each word a note. Point at one and the phrase plays from it; or sing along discs on the staff; or draw the staff only where there are words.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: A bounded reading: your figure in large italic above a dimension line, one accent index locating it between its limits. Space remains space; nothing fills it in.

items.name: mode-toggle
items.title: Mode toggle
items.description: The way from day to night, drawn ten ways. Three are switches with a scene change of their own: Day over Night with the full stop setting from one to the other while the page dissolves; Night taking the ink letter by letter while the page's light is lowered; Noon turning to Moon while night falls from the top. The other seven are buttons: a disc sliding over a ring, a dot setting below a hairline, a word on a hairline that rolls, the fermata as an eye, a sentence whose last word rolls, midday whose second half the ink falls over, and a clock turning from noon to midnight.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: A number on a baseline, yours in italic and formatted; less and more step it, and each step turns the changed figures over like a counter. Or it stands over a small ruler you can drag.

items.name: pie-chart
items.title: Pie chart
items.description: Shares of a whole: one hairline ring cut into arcs with paper between them, numbered round the rim, and the total as one very large number inside that rolls to the share of the arc you point at.

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Several measures on one shape: a hairline polygon on a dotted construction sheet, each axis named in small caps at its end, and the axis you point at measured off as a dimension line with its figure on it.

items.name: radial-chart
items.title: Radial chart
items.description: Progress against one maximum: a hairline ring per series with its arc inked as far as it has got, and one very large number inside that rolls to the ring you point at.

items.name: reading-trail
items.title: Reading trail
items.description: Keep your place on a long page: its sections by number and name, set as a contents page, the one you are in carrying the accent while its dotted leader inks as you read. Or the page's own rail, with that section running down it like the title on a spine.

items.name: reverb
items.title: Reverb
items.description: A phrase that echoes into silence: each line quieter, more open and a dynamic smaller, drifting right like a canon, answering from either wall, or losing its consonants first; it ends on a rest.

items.name: scroll-expand
items.title: Scroll expand
items.description: A plate cropped by four corner marks that open with the scroll, from a small mark to the full measure, and stop when you stop.

items.name: segue
items.title: Segue
items.description: One scene at a time. When you change it, one hairline crosses the frame carrying the next scene's number and name, and the next scene is already behind it.

items.name: sign
items.title: Sign
items.description: An icon made of its own word with Pretext: ruled in middle-dot leaders, laid along its strokes, or filling its silhouette row by row. Pointed at, it says itself.

items.name: source
items.title: Source
items.description: Code, set as type. Weight is the only highlighting, what someone wrote is italic, and a bracket joins the lines like a system in a score.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A named value: a giant thin figure whose feet sink under one hairline, the name small beneath; a changed figure turns over like a counter's wheels.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: A real sequence. Numbered in large thin figures in the margin; or the figures stand on one line and rise out of it as you reach them; or the titles step across the page like a broken headline; or, compact, the whole sequence folded into one fraction beside the step you're on.

items.name: swapy
items.title: Swapy
items.description: Rows you put in order by hand. A move word is the handle; the row you hold reverses out of ink and travels with you, or a proofreader's loop marks where it went.

items.name: text-ribbon
items.title: Text ribbon
items.description: A phrase travelling along an arch or a wave, measured by pretext. Drag, keys and scroll take over; pause holds it in place.

items.name: tiling
items.title: Tiling
items.description: Tiles on the 12-column grid, held apart by space and one hairline, never boxed. Leave the sheet still, or drag a tile and pull its corner: the grid makes room for your arrangement.

items.name: timer
items.title: Timer
items.description: A countdown the person starts: the time set large inside a hairline ring that empties clockwise behind the accent dot, the figures turning over like a counter's wheels. Done, a full stop lands.

items.name: tour
items.title: Tour
items.description: A tour of callouts: each step an ink callout hung on a leader line that ends in a dot on the thing it is about, one step at a time, only when you press on.

items.name: tree
items.title: Tree
items.description: A hierarchy set as a contents page: names on hairline branches, each hanging from under its folder's first letter, a folder opened at a time.

items.name: wake
items.title: Wake
items.description: A paragraph that parts around your pointer like water around a hand: the lines it crosses split in two and the words move on.

items.name: waterfall
items.title: Waterfall
items.description: A type specimen waterfall: one sentence at every dynamic, loudest first, each line filled to the measure with as many whole words as the size holds.

items.name: word-relay
items.title: Word relay
items.description: A sentence whose last word rolls on every 2.4 seconds, in the italic. Press or use the keys to take over, or pause to hold a word.

items.title: Sign: search (dots)
items.description: The sign for "search": its strokes ruled in middle-dot leaders. Says the word when pointed at.

items.title: Sign: search (words)
items.description: The sign for "search": the word set along its strokes. Says the word when pointed at.
